> [!IMPORTANT]
> PLEASE DO NOT PUBLISH SECURITY FINDINGS PUBLICLY.

To align with the transparency philosophy of the Moodle ecosystem and to demonstrate responsibility regarding the code, we request that any security flaws be reported through private channels rather than by opening a public issue.

To establish a secure line of communication, please use GitHub’s native private vulnerability reporting feature. For this repository, this function is enabled under the "Security and quality" tab and can be accessed via the following link: [https://github.com/davidherney/moodle-format_onetopic/security](https://github.com/davidherney/moodle-format_onetopic/security).
